merits.name: Nerve Bar
merits.description: This upgrade will give you +1 extra nerve point on your maximum nerve.

merits.name: Critical Hit Rate
merits.description: This upgrade will give you an extra 0.5% chance at getting a critical hit during attacks. Critical hits are blows made on an opponent's head, throat or heart during an attack.

merits.name: Awareness
merits.description: This upgrade will increase the amount of items you can find in the city by 20%, however it will not necessarily increase their quality.

merits.name: Masterful Looting
merits.description: This upgrade will give you a 5% boost in money that you mug from opponents. Perfect for experienced muggers, looking for some extra cash.

merits.name: Stealth
merits.description: This upgrade will make you more likely to stay stealthed when beating an opponent by increasing your stealth level by +0.2. When you're stealthed, your name will be listed as 'Someone' so your enemy will not know who hit them.

merits.name: Bank Interest
merits.description: This upgrade will give you an increase of 5% to your investment bank interest. This upgrade will start working on your next investment.

merits.name: Hospitalizing
merits.description: This upgrade will increase the amount of time you hospitalize someone by 5%. Make sure they feel the burn with 50% extra hospital time when fully upgraded.

merits.name: Brawn
merits.description: This upgrade will give you a passive 3% bonus to your strength stat. This upgrade will not increase your actual viewable stat number, but you will notice the effects during attacks.

merits.name: Sharpness
merits.description: This upgrade will give you a passive 3% bonus to your speed stat. This upgrade will not increase your actual viewable stat number, but you will notice the effects during attacks.

merits.name: Evasion
merits.description: This upgrade will give you a passive 3% bonus to your dexterity stat. This upgrade will not increase your actual viewable stat number, but you will notice the effects during attacks.

merits.name: Protection
merits.description: This upgrade will give you a passive 3% bonus to your defense stat. This upgrade will not increase your actual viewable stat number, but you will notice the effects during attacks.

merits.name: Life Points
merits.description: This upgrade will increase your maximum life by 5%. This upgrade works great with your defense and might keep you going a little longer during attacks.

merits.name: Crime XP
merits.description: This upgrade will give you a passive boost of 3% (per upgrade) to your Crime XP resulting in increased success rates.

merits.name: Education Length
merits.description: This upgrade will decrease the amount of time you have to wait to complete an education course by 2%. This upgrade will start working on the next education course you start.

merits.name: Heavy Artillery Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Heavy Artillery weapons include: Flamethrower, RPG Launcher, and Type 98 Anti Tank.

merits.name: Machine Gun Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Machine Gun weapons include: M249 SAW, Rheinmetall MG 3, and Minigun.

merits.name: Rifle Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Rifle weapons include: AK-47, Enfield SA-80, and ArmaLite M-15A4.

merits.name: SMG Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. SMG weapons include: P90, MP5 Navy, and 9mm Uzi.

merits.name: Shotgun Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Shotgun weapons include: Jackhammer, Mag 7, and Ithaca 37.

merits.name: Pistol Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Pistol weapons include: Glock 17, Desert Eagle, and Flare Gun.

merits.name: Club Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Clubbing weapons include: Baseball Bat, Frying Pan, and Axe (Melee weapons that usually just cause a heavy blow).

merits.name: Piercing Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Piercing weapons include: Pen Knife and Dagger (Melee weapons that you stab with to pierce the skin).

merits.name: Slashing Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Slashing weapons include: Samurai Sword and Scimitar (Swords and other weapons that you would slash with).

merits.name: Mechanical Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Mechanical devices include: Chainsaw and Taser (Weapons with an electronic or engineered system).

merits.name: Temporary Mastery
merits.description: This upgrade will improve your proficiency with these weapons, increasing damage by 1% and accuracy by +0.2. Temporary weapons include: Grenade, Ninja Star, and Molotov Cocktail (Temporary weapons that cause damage).

merits.name: Addiction Mitigation
merits.description: This upgrade will reduce the negative effects that addiction causes by 2%. Addiction will have less of an impact on your battle stats, employee effectiveness, and education / gym access.

merits.name: Employee Effectiveness
merits.description: This upgrade will provide an additional +1 bonus to employee effectiveness, helping you to earn more money for the company you work for.
